note: The sizing half of hif-backend#91, kept apart from vhdl_ascending_range which covers the indexing half and declares no ascending-typed constant on purpose. hif2verilog used to size a bitvector literal as left-right+1, which is the width only for a descending range; for (0 to 3) that was -2, so `"1100"` was emitted as `-2'b1100`. iverilog took two bits, truncated to 2'b00, negated to zero, warned twice and exited 0 - the mask became all zeros and y was always 0000 instead of a's high half. The size is now the distance between the bounds. This design indexes nothing, so a fix to the index mapping alone cannot make it pass and a fix to the sizing alone cannot make vhdl_ascending_range pass.
